offers.name: Gniewka Shadow Linter
offers.description: JS bookmarklet + Python CLI (`pip install gniewka-shadow-linter`, `gnsl check file.md`). Wykrywa: (1) AI-slop frazy ~30 (PL+EN: 'unlock', 'unleash', 'odblokuj', 'rewolucyjny', 'transform your', 'in today's fast-paced world'); (2) hidden watermarks Unicode (U+200B ZWSP / U+FEFF BOM / U+00A0 NBSP / soft hyphens); (3) tonal flags (superlative density, passive voice >40%, exclamation density >1.5%); (4) em-dash mid-sentence excess. Score 0-100 banded GREEN (0-25 human) / YELLOW / ORANGE / RED (75-100 pure GPT slop). Export JSON + highlighted HTML. Demo live działa na landingu (testowane Node v25.2.1: clean=0, slop sample=100).
offers.audience: developers, content marketers, editors, indie writers którzy chcą wiedzieć czy ich tekst brzmi jak GPT
